title: Reporting: from core and BIRT to the reports add-on
description: Report generation as recorded in the zaproxy and zap-extensions histories: core report classes in the first import, the 2013 BIRT add-on, the reports add-on from March 2021 and the removal of the older code.

chapters.title: Report classes in the first core import
chapters.text: The zaproxy commit "Version 1.0.0" (2010-09-04) includes org/parosproxy/paros/extension/report/ExtensionReport.java, ReportGenerator.java and ReportLastScan.java. Later core commits touch them, for example "Support Markdown format Fixes #2886 ..." (2016-09-22) and "support JSON format for reports add API option to output report in JSON format fix #3559" (2017-06-29).

chapters.title: BIRT reporting add-on, October 2013
chapters.text: The zap-extensions commit "BIRT Reporting with XML data source and Scripting - GSoC 2013 by Rauf Butt" is dated 2013-10-09. It adds a birtreports extension with classes such as AlertReport, BirtTopMenu and ReportLastScan. "Added birtreports jars to top level lib directory" follows on 2013-10-14.

chapters.title: A new reports add-on, March 2021
chapters.text: "Report Generation - first version" (2021-03-09) is the first commit under addOns/reports. The CHANGELOG lists 0.0.1 (2021-03-09) as "First version." 0.2.0 (2021-04-12) adds "Support for template sections", 0.3.0 (2021-05-06) adds "API Support." and "Promote to beta", and 0.4.0 (2021-06-28) adds "Modern template - submitted via the ZAP Reporting Competition" and "Traditional JSON report".

chapters.title: Older report add-ons and core reports removed in 2021
chapters.text: On 2021-04-06 the commit "Remove superseded report add-ons" says "Remove `alertReport`, `birtreports`, `customreport`, and `exportreport`." In zaproxy, "Redirect core API reports to report add-on" is dated 2021-06-23 and "Remove Paros Reports" is dated 2021-07-22; the latter deletes ReportGeneratorUnitTest among 1064 removed lines.

chapters.title: More formats and the Automation Framework
chapters.text: The CHANGELOG lists, for 0.5.0 (2021-08-05), "Automation Framework 'theme' parameter." and "Automation Framework GUI"; for 0.4.0, "Automation job: outputSummary, aimed at mimicking the output of the packaged scans."; for 0.16.0 (2022-10-27), ""XML Plus" report format for XML with requests and responses"; and for 0.17.0 (2022-11-22), "SARIF reporting". The dataset lists the add-on as a release and as depending on automation.

chapters.title: State at HEAD
chapters.text: The newest release in the CHANGELOG is 0.46.0 (2026-07-06), which lists "Added script diagnostics section to Traditional Reports." and, as a fix, exclusion of invalid alerts from generated reports (Issue 6880).
